# Kalshi trader behaviour (generated by analysis/trader_behavior.py; do not edit by hand)

2,532,075 non-block taker trades, 88,904,307 contracts, 28,626,774 dollars of premium, 365 days. Returns are per contract held to settlement; the fee is Kalshi's taker fee (ceil of 0.07 × count × P × (1 − P) cents per trade). Intervals resample whole days.

- 1% of contracts trade before the noon cutoff on D-1, 10% between the cutoff and the target day, 89% on the target day itself.
- On test days the Kalshi midpoint is already better than the noon ML forecast at its earliest complete quote (-14 hours from the target day start): Brier 0.1117 vs 0.1129.
